rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone gasping or short of breath.

example.english: After running up the stairs, I sat down, breathless.
example.traditional: 跑完樓梯，我氣喘吁吁咁坐低。
example.jyutping: paau2 jyun4 lau4 tai1 ngo5 hei3 cyun2 heoi1 heoi1 gam2 co5 dai1

rows.note: Use this for something thrilling or exciting enough to make people hold their breath.

example.english: The match was so thrilling it left me breathless.
example.traditional: 呢場賽事刺激到我差啲唔敢呼吸。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 coi3 si6 cik3 gik1 dou3 ngo5 caa1 di1 m4 gam2 fu1 kap1

rows.note: Use this when someone is no longer breathing or appears dead, with the context making the meaning clear.

example.english: After the fall, they did not move at all and looked breathless, as if dead.
example.traditional: 佢跌低之後，一郁都唔郁，睇落冇氣喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dit3 dai1 zi1 hau6 jat1 juk1 dou1 m4 juk1 tai2 lok6 mou5 hei3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for language or headlines that are excessively emotional or hysterical rather than simply exciting.

example.english: This news article is so breathless and emotional that it makes people uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 呢篇新聞寫得太煽情，睇到人都唔舒服。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 san1 man4 se2 dak1 taai3 sin3 cing4 tai2 dou3 jan4 dou1 m4 syu1 fuk6
